root_cause: Host firewall rules update (change CHG-4490) applied just before the incident denies egress to reference-db, causing connection refused errors in order-gateway.
summary: Escalated to on-call: No safe action within the runbooks: Firewall rule update change CHG-4490 caused reference-db connections to be refused by order-gateway, leading to errors and HTTP 503 rejections. Rollback to restore connectivity and service.
